title: Vulva
summary: The vulva is the external part of the female genitals: the mons, outer and inner labia, the external clitoris, the urethral opening and the vaginal opening.
key_points: People often say 'vagina' when they mean the vulva; the vagina is the internal canal.
Vulvas vary a lot in colour, shape and labia size; variation is normal.
The vulva cleans itself well with plain water; scented washes can irritate it.
answer_guidance: Use correct anatomical words calmly. If the user mixes up vulva and vagina, clarify gently without lecturing.
